{{Quote|Your objective is to save as much of the Ripoblus convoy as possible. This will be accomplished by destroying enough of the attacking Dimoks to force the rest to withdraw. The survivors will report back to their leaders. Hopefully, their leaders will quickly realize the futility of further armed struggle.|[[Imperial briefing officer]]|<ref name="TF">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''Dimoks''', colloquially known as the '''Dims''',<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> were a cultural group of the [[Sepan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]],<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> one of the two primary [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|189|Dimok}}</ref>

The Dimoks were involved with the [[Ripoblus (people)|people]] of [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]] in the [[Sepan Civil War]], a conflict which lasted intermittently for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_2.html|Sepan Civil War Escalates}}</ref><ref name="TF" /><ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
The Dimoks were at [[Sepan Civil War|war]] with their neighbors, the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]], for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] as of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="HNN" /> and up until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Sepan campaign|arrived]] in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="TF" /> The Dimoks supported the Empire before they were betrayed and attacked by the invaders. At this point, the Dimoks and the Ripoblus made peace with each other in an attempt to drive out the Empire. However, this temporary alliance failed, as the Dimoks and the Ripoblus did not have the military might to oppose the Empire.<ref name="TF" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] and [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] put down the [[Sepan]] forces,<ref name="TF" /> effectively ending the [[Sepan Civil War]] for several decades.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

Old arguments started up again in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], triggering a new war in the Sepan [[Star system/Legends|system]]. This time, though, it was the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] who worked to stop the fighting as Imperial control in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had drastically shrunk.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> The war between the Dimoks and their rivals was still ongoing as of [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
